[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.45] (3) This paragraph applies where—

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.45] (a)an application under section 36 (incomplete written statement) or section 37 27 (incorrect statement: contract-holder’s application to the court) of the 2016 Act has been made (and not disposed of) in connection with the occupation contract of the dwelling in respect of which the possession claim has been brought;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.45] (b)the claim is a claim under section 178 or section 199 of the 2016 Act, where the issue of retaliatory possession has been raised under section 217 of the 2016 Act 28 ;

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.45] (c)the claim is a claim under section 170, section 178, section 186, section 191 or section 199 29 of the 2016 Act, where a defence based on the defendant’s Convention rights is raised. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.45] (5) The court is to give all parties not less than 14 days’ notice of a hearing fixed under paragraph (1)(c)(i). [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.45] (6) Where a claim is struck out under paragraph (1)(b)—

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.45] (a)the court is to serve its reasons for striking out the claim with the order; and

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.45] (b)the claimant may apply to restore the claim within 28 days after the date the order was served on them. ## Possession order

## 55.46

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.46] Except where rules 55.45(1)(b) or (c) apply, the judge must make an order for possession without requiring the attendance of the parties. ## Postponement of possession

## 55.47

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.47] (1) Where the defendant seeks postponement of possession on the ground of exceptional hardship under section 219 30 of the 2016 Act, the judge may direct a hearing of that issue. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.47] (2) Where the judge directs a hearing under paragraph (1)—

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.47] (a)the hearing must be held before the date on which possession is to be given up; and

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.47] (b)the judge must direct how many days’ notice the parties must be given of that hearing. [PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.47] (3) Where the judge is satisfied, on a hearing directed under paragraph (1), that exceptional hardship would be caused by requiring possession to be given up by the date in the order of possession, the judge may vary the date on which possession must be given up. ## Application to set aside or vary

## 55.48

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.48] The court may—

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.48] (a)on application by a party within 14 days of service of the order; or

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.48] (b)of its own initiative,

[PART 55 – POSSESSION CLAIMS > 55.48] set aside or vary any order made under rule 55.46. ## Footnotes
